creation.prompt: Edit reference 1, the owner-selected portrait base, to create a reusable facial acting variant. Reference 2 owns canonical identity and reference 3 only measurement guides. Preserve the approved Milo canonical identity, lean grey felt anatomy, cream muzzle and belly boundaries, moss-green eyes, orange tail, canonical ears, eyes and paw construction. Short readable neck; no enlarged head, wide belly, shortened limbs or independently scaled body parts. Canonical upright projected head fraction 0.39 +/-0.01 applies only at comparable upright angle/support, never crouch or tumble. Use annotated visible-surface width, cream patch and paw references at comparable views, not hidden-joint guesses. Do not render annotations. Mouth closed, no teeth, no speech mouth. Genuine transparent alpha, neutral soft light, no background, ground plane, props, labels or shadows. Exactly one candidate; no variants. Keep reference 1 head silhouette, three-quarter forward-right head angle, head/ear/eye/muzzle sizes and positions, short neck, shoulder and upper-chest crop exactly compatible. Full ears and whiskers with clearance. Change only eyebrows, eyelids, gaze and restrained closed-muzzle crease to express: Sudden alarm: widened eyelids, raised brows and startled gaze, tense closed muzzle. Do not enlarge skull or change iris/ear design to amplify emotion. This face asset will require local pitch/roll/view registration before use on ducked or falling bodies; do not rotate or distort the base in this request.
